🎬 Down Periscope (1996)

Down Periscope follows Lieutenant Commander Thomas Dodge, an unconventional United States Navy officer who finally receives the opportunity to command his own submarine. However, instead of receiving a modern vessel, he is assigned an outdated diesel-powered submarine, the USS Stingray, and a crew of eccentric sailors. Tasked with participating in a challenging naval war game against superior nuclear-powered submarines, Dodge must rely on creativity, unconventional tactics, and teamwork to prove his abilities. Despite facing skepticism from his superiors and numerous unexpected obstacles, he gradually transforms his inexperienced crew into a capable team. Starring Kelsey Grammer, Lauren Holly, and Rob Schneider, the film combines hilarious military comedy, entertaining adventures, and memorable characters while exploring leadership, friendship, perseverance, and the importance of believing in others.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Military • Adventure

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 32m • PG-13

🎥 Director: David S. Ward

source_details.synopsis: Down Periscope is a 1996 American military comedy submarine film directed by David S. Ward, produced by Robert Lawrence, and starring Kelsey Grammer, Lauren Holly and Rob Schneider along with Bruce Dern, Harry Dean Stanton, William H. Macy and Rip Torn in supporting roles. Released by 20th Century Fox on March 1, 1996, the film focuses on Lieutenant Commander Thomas Dodge (played by Grammer), a capable, if somewhat unorthodox, U.S. Navy officer who fights to save his career after being saddled with a group of misfit seamen who have been brought together as the crew of his first command, USS Stingray, a rusty, obsolete World War II-era diesel submarine that is the focus of a special naval war
